desc:
Run, gain EXP, level up and unlock super speed! Every step makes you stronger and faster. Train, upgrade your gear and compete in exciting race challenges to reach max speed.

How to play:
🏃 Run to gain EXP and level up
⚡ Increase your speed every level
🏁 Compete in speed races
💤 Train on AFK treadmills and earn EXP while idle
👟 Buy boots, auras, trails, and other upgrades
💰 Upgrade your wallet to earn more rewards
🌍 Reach new areas and run farther than anyone else

💎 Features:
Speed simulator progression
Powerful gear upgrades
AFK training and idle farming
Awesome auras and trails
Challenging race simulator gameplay
Climb the leaderboard and become the fastest runner
Roblox Premium subscribers grants 50% EXP Boost!

🏆 Train hard, get stronger and reach infinite speed!
👍 If you enjoy running games, speed parkour simulators, obby racing simulators, AFK training games, and progression simulators, this game is for you.
